answer: The strongest single control I know for this is reputation credential accumulated across epochs, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 110 POA of exposure, so 779 aliases carry 85690 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. One trellis of signal, one meadow of cost, one atlas of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
